hood.name: Rear hood (engine cover)
hood.desc: Lift for the engine, air cleaner, radiator and oil cooler. After every use blow or brush debris off the radiator and oil cooler; check for oil, fuel and coolant leaks daily.

engine.name: Engine: Yanmar 3TNV74F 3-cyl diesel
engine.desc: 993 cc liquid-cooled indirect-injection diesel, 14.6 kW (19.6 hp). Oil 2.2 L with filter: JD Plus-50 II or Torq-Gard Supreme (else API CD+ / ACEA E3+ multigrade). Change oil and filter warm every 500 h or yearly (not 50 h). Check high and low idle at 500 h. 20 A alternator, not the 48 V unit on the E-Cut Hybrid.

oilfilter.name: Engine oil filter
oilfilter.desc: Spin-on. Oil the gasket, hand tight then a further 1/2 turn. Change with the oil every 500 h or yearly.

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner (primary and secondary elements)
aircleaner.desc: Check the restriction indicator and the rubber dust unloading valve daily. Replace both elements together every 500 h or yearly, then reset the indicator. Do not wash or blow out the elements.

radiator.name: Radiator, oil cooler and coolant
radiator.desc: Coolant 3.5 L JD Cool-Gard II pre-mix (or 40-60 % concentrate). Check level daily. Drain, flush and refill every 6 years / 6,000 h with Cool-Gard II, or every 2 years / 2,000 h if any other coolant is in it. Check radiator and intake hoses and clamps at the same time.

belt.name: Fan / alternator belt
belt.desc: Check every 200 h: 9.5 mm deflection at mid-span with thumb pressure. Part number not confirmed in any 2550 source: order by PIN.

battery.name: 12 V battery
battery.desc: 12 V, 500 CCA, reserve 68 min. Clean terminals every 50 h. JD now offers TY27806B (425 CCA) as a substitute: below the OM spec, so prefer a local BCI group 51 battery of at least 500 CCA.

fueltank.name: Fuel tank and injection system
fueltank.desc: 29.5 L of ULSD (15 ppm sulphur max, up to B7). Tank position is not marked on the photo. Refuel after use. Dealer checks: injectors every 1,500 h or 24 months, injection pump every 3,000 h or 36 months.

fuelsep.name: Sediment bowl and fuel filter element
fuelsep.desc: Check daily: the orange ring floats on water, so drain and clean if it has risen. Replace the element every 500 h or yearly: close the fuel tap first and bleed per the OM. The bowl and head assembly is only needed if damaged.

hydtank.name: Hydraulic reservoir, filter and strainer
hydtank.desc: JD Hy-Gard J20C only (not J20D or type F ATF): 28.8 L system, 20.4 L reservoir. Check level daily (aux reservoir HOT/COLD marks). Every 750 h or yearly: drain both reservoirs, change the filter (right side under the seat, hand tight + 1/2 to 3/4 turn), clean the suction strainer (left side, refit 27-34 N.m). Drain plug 9.5 N.m with sealant, fill plug 27 N.m. Change the filter early if its indicator shows red. Clean the mow valve screen every 500 h. LVU14258 is the optional high-performance filter: fit whichever is on the can.

rops.name: ROPS and seat belt
rops.desc: Check the seat belt daily. Check torque on the ROPS hardware every 500 h or yearly. Do not drill, weld or modify the ROPS.

seat.name: Operator seat
seat.desc: Seat switch is a safety interlock: test it daily with the engine running. The seat switch number in the old parts list (M127234) could not be verified: order by PIN.

console.name: Control console
console.desc: Console beside the seat carrying the operator controls (levers as shown in the photo). Test the mow-transport and raise-lower lever interlock switches daily.

steering.name: Steering wheel and column
steering.desc: Steers the single rear wheel. Check steering, pedals and the seat belt daily before mowing.

frame.name: Main frame, footplate and pedals
frame.desc: Hydrostatic drive: the pedals give dynamic braking and a dual-disc park brake holds the machine. Test the brakes and park brake daily. Check for loose, missing or damaged parts and that all guards are fitted. Grease machine fittings with JD Special Purpose HD Water Resistant or Multi-Purpose HD Lithium Complex.

fenders.name: Front fenders and step
fenders.desc: Moulded fenders over the front tyres. Keep clear of grass build-up; check mounts for cracks.

liftF.name: Lift arms, carrier frame and reel hoses
liftF.desc: Grease the front lift-arm pivots and the centre lift-arm pivot every 50 h with the units lowered to the ground. Check all hoses and clamps every 200 h. Use the OM reel motor diagnostics chart before replacing a slow or stalling reel motor.

tyreFL.name: Front tyre and wheel, left
tyreFL.desc: Smooth 2-ply tyre 69-83 kPa (10-12 psi); 4-ply smooth or balloon 103 kPa (15 psi). Check pressure daily: uneven pressure gives an uneven cut. Wheel hardware checked at break-in.

tyreFR.name: Front tyre and wheel, right
tyreFR.desc: Smooth 2-ply tyre 69-83 kPa (10-12 psi); 4-ply smooth or balloon 103 kPa (15 psi). Check pressure daily: uneven pressure gives an uneven cut. Wheel hardware checked at break-in.

tyreR.name: Rear tyre and steering spindle
tyreR.desc: Same pressures as the front (2-ply 69-83 kPa, 4-ply 103 kPa). Grease the rear wheel steering spindle and the rear wheel bearings every 50 h.

cu1.name: Cutting unit, centre (rear)
cu1.desc: 22 in. QA5 cutting unit, 5 in. reel (7, 11 or 14 blade), hydraulic reel drive, HOC range 2.0-22 mm. Now cutting tees and surrounds at 4 mm: fit UC18869 Tournament or ET11066, never UC23562 or UC28156. Paper test daily. Grease the yoke pivot, reel bearings, both rollers and the rear-roller HOC adjusters every 50 h and straight after washing, with JD Golf and Turf Cutting Unit Grease; do not over-grease.

cu2.name: Cutting unit, front right
cu2.desc: 22 in. QA5 cutting unit, 5 in. reel (7, 11 or 14 blade), hydraulic reel drive, HOC range 2.0-22 mm. Now cutting tees and surrounds at 4 mm: fit UC18869 Tournament or ET11066, never UC23562 or UC28156. Paper test daily. Grease the yoke pivot, reel bearings, both rollers and the rear-roller HOC adjusters every 50 h and straight after washing, with JD Golf and Turf Cutting Unit Grease; do not over-grease.

cu3.name: Cutting unit, front left
cu3.desc: 22 in. QA5 cutting unit, 5 in. reel (7, 11 or 14 blade), hydraulic reel drive, HOC range 2.0-22 mm. Now cutting tees and surrounds at 4 mm: fit UC18869 Tournament or ET11066, never UC23562 or UC28156. Paper test daily. Grease the yoke pivot, reel bearings, both rollers and the rear-roller HOC adjusters every 50 h and straight after washing, with JD Golf and Turf Cutting Unit Grease; do not over-grease.

reel.name: Reel (5 in., 7 / 11 / 14 blades)
reel.desc: Backlap all three units together: operator off the seat, park brake on, slow reel speed, coarse then fine compound (about 80 then 120 grit), wash off while still reversing, then reset clearance. Grind when backlapping no longer restores a clean cut: spin grind then relief grind, then backlap off the burr. Count the blades before ordering.

bedknife.name: Bedknife and support
bedknife.desc: Clearance 0.025-0.050 mm: one flat at a time, alternate sides, finish pulling the knife away from the reel. 13 new 21M7194 screws per knife at 7 N.m, centre outwards. Grind with the support: 6.5 deg top relief, front relief 15 deg (low-cut) or 5 deg (high-cut). Minimum HOC: UC28163 / TCU36165 2.0 mm, UC18869 2.5 mm, JRM 4BD250103 2.9 mm, ET11066 3.2 mm, UC28156 4.8 mm, UC23562 7.6 mm; UC18873 not stated.

froller.name: Front roller (2 in.)
froller.desc: Grease both ends every 50 h. Bracket position 3 gives 1-9.5 mm HOC without a groomer or brush (position 2 is 0-4 mm, too close at 4 mm); with GTC, FTC or brush use position 3 (0-11 mm). Set parallel to the reel after a knife change. Part number not in the bible: order by PIN.

rroller.name: Rear roller and HOC adjusters
rroller.desc: Grease both roller ends and the HOC adjusters every 50 h. Set HOC, backlap, then recheck HOC after any knife change.

brush.name: Rear roller power brush (if fitted)
brush.desc: Synchronous drive belt 375 mm. Grease the brush or conditioner supports every 50 h and tighten the collet nut every 200 h.

motor.name: Reel motor (hydraulic)
motor.desc: Runs on the main Hy-Gard system. Use the OM reel motor diagnostics chart for a slow or stalling reel before replacing the motor. Motor part number not in the bible: order by PIN.

cuframe.name: Cutting unit frame and yoke
cuframe.desc: Complete QA5 22 in. 11-blade unit BUC10415 replaces BM25128. Grease the yoke pivot every 50 h.

basket.name: Grass catcher
basket.desc: Empty before it overfills. Wash out with the cutting unit after use.

LVU14258.name: Hydraulic oil filter, high performance (option)
LVU14258.note: Fits the 2550; standard on the 2700/2750. Fit whichever filter is on the machine.

TCA19350.name: Reel 22 in., 7-blade
TCA19350.note: Fits 2550 PrecisionCut per JD shop. Count the blades before ordering.

TCA23621.name: Reel 22 in., 14-blade
TCA23621.note: Fits 2550 PrecisionCut per JD shop. Count the blades before ordering.

JRM 4BD250103.name: Bedknife, JRM extended-cut tournament 13-hole (aftermarket)
JRM 4BD250103.note: OEM ref ET17534 (now UC18869). Min HOC 2.9 mm. GA Power Equipment Spares. No AU price found.

MIA884996: Fuel filter assembly (bowl/head): only if damaged
TY25876B: JD dealer or local battery supplier
UC18869: Emmetts / Brandt (OEM); GA Power Equipment Spares (JRM)
ET11066: Bedknife, Standard 22 in. with hardened insert (min HOC 3.2 mm)
TCU36165: Bedknife, Hardened less-aggressive low-cut 22 in. (min HOC 2.0 mm)
UC28156: Bedknife, Fairway low-cut 22 in. (min HOC 4.8 mm)
UC23562: Bedknife, Fairway high-cut 22 in. (min HOC 7.6 mm)
21M7194: Bedknife screw M6 x 12 countersunk (13 per knife)
TCA19351: Reel 22 in., 11-blade (7 and 14 blade also fit)
BUC10415: Complete QA5 22 in. 11-blade cutting unit (2 mm knife)
TCU32422: Rear roller power-brush drive belt (only if PowerBrush fitted)

model.note: Part outlines on the photo are drawn by hand and approximate. The photo is John Deere's current 2550 PrecisionCut studio image; the club's 2022 machine (PIN 1TC2550HVNT030138) may differ in detail. Part numbers come from operator's manual omuc24434 (Export Edition), JD parts site fit lists and the JD 2750 Replacement Parts Guide (same QA5 cutting unit and filter set). Read the plates before ordering: reel blade count, hydraulic filter (AM102723 or LVU14258) and bedknife fitted.
